A reader on Mill Row writes that the allotment water butts were emptied without notice for the
second summer running. The parish office says the butts were cleaned and refilled the same week.

Another reader asks whether the Saturday market will move indoors for the winter. It will, from
the first week of November, to the church hall.

The Courier thanks the reader who returned the borrowed folding chairs.
